name: Wild Hunt
description: The elven ritual hunt that Oko arranges to kill the stag and start a war.

description_citations.work: Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest
description_citations.text: "Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Garruk joins the twins in chasing the Wild Hunt to save their father, and Oko, disguised as Ayara, shoots the stag.
timeline.quote: Oko took the form of the elven queen Ayara and shot the stag in the chest with an arrow.

citation.text: "Garruk", section "The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko turns the High King into a stag and puts it to sleep, planning to have the Wild Hunt find it.
timeline.quote: he had transformed the High King into a stag and had magically put it to sleep

citation.text: "Oko", section "The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Wild Hunt kills the stag, and Linden restores Algenus with his Questing Sword.
timeline.quote: bringing Algenus back to life by using his Questing Sword

citation.text: "Rowan Kenrith", section "The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The twins fail to protect the stag from the Wild Hunt; Linden restores the High King.
timeline.quote: bringing Algenus back to life by using his Questing Sword.

citation.text: "Will Kenrith", section "The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
